full_judgment:
9. Mr. Md. Rabiul Alam Chowdhurdy lastly submits that the impugned judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal. 

 10. Dr. Rafiqur Rahman, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner in C.R. No. 2974 of 1999 adopts the submissions of the learned Advocate Mr. Md. Rabiul Alam Chowdhury and added that in the plaint of the earlier Title Suit No. 346 of 1977 the cause of action for the suit was mentioned as dated 21.7.1977 which was the date of the alleged transfers by 11 kabalas by Rathindra Nath basak in favour of the plaintiffs of the earlier suit and this clearly shows that the decree was obtained by practicing fraud upon the court. Dr. Rahman further submits that Rathindra Nath Basak was not a recorded owner of the S.A. Khatian and that the earlier suit was filed on the found of wrong record of the suit land which clearly indicate that the suit land was transferred by Rathindra Nath Basak who was not legally entitled to make any transfer of the suit land on 21.7.1977 when the suit land was treated as vested and non-resident property and was leased out to the petitioner (defendant No. 12) Dr. Rahman also submits that the impugned judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal but ondidly admits that he has no leg to stands unless the plaintiff succeeds in the suit and the suit land remains vested and non-resident property.
